title: Why Nobody Replies to Your LinkedIn DMs | The Cold Message Formula That Gets Replies
description:
Why Nobody Replies to Your LinkedIn DMs | The Cold Message Formula That Gets Replies


The average cold LinkedIn message gets a reply 1 to 2% of the time. The messages that actually work get replies at 10 to 20%. Same person sending. Same senior people on the other end. The only thing that changed is the structure of 4 or 5 sentences.

This video breaks down exactly why your LinkedIn messages are getting ignored, the 3 bad messages recruiters delete on sight, and the 3-part formula that takes a cold message from opened and ignored to a senior person writing back within 48 hours.


What you'll learn in this video:
- Why silence is almost never personal (and the 4 actual reasons people don't reply)
- The 3 worst LinkedIn messages every recruiter deletes on sight
- The 3-part cold message formula that gets replies at 10 to 20%
- 4 plug-and-play variations for every kind of contact (alumni, ex-colleagues, post engagement, event references)
- The follow-up cadence that turns silence into conversations (7, 14, 21 days)
